title: Rooftop Chase: Tag in the Virtual City
description: The player controls Xbot navigating through a virtual city to chase and tag Kira, who patrols between waypoints on the city streets. The player must use WASD keys to move Xbot close enough to Kira to tag her within a time limit, while Kira dynamically evades when the player gets near.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a 3D chase-tag game. Load three GLB assets using GLTFLoader: Xbot.glb as the player character, kira.glb as the AI opponent, and VirtualCity.glb as the environment. Set up the scene with a directional light casting soft shadows, ambient light for fill, and a hemisphere light for sky color. Place VirtualCity at the origin and scale it so it forms a playable arena. Position Xbot and Kira on the ground plane of the city, separated by a reasonable distance. Implement WASD keyboard controls to move Xbot in world space at a steady walk speed. Play Xbot's walk animation from its embedded AnimationClip when moving, and idle animation when stationary. Kira should patrol between 4 predefined waypoints in the city using linear interpolation, playing her walk animation. When Xbot comes within 15 units of Kira, she enters an evasion state: she picks a new random waypoint away from Xbot and increases her speed by 1.5x. Attach a third-person camera that follows Xbot from behind and slightly above, using lerp for smooth tracking. Display an HTML overlay UI showing: (1) a 60-second countdown timer, (2) distance to Kira updated each frame, (3) a status message. The player must move Xbot within 2 units of Kira to tag her. When tagged, freeze both characters, play idle animations, show a 'You Win!' message with the remaining time. If the timer expires, show 'Time Up!' in red. Add a restart button that resets positions, timer, and game state. Use AnimationMixer for both characters. Ensure the renderer uses antialiasing, toneMapping set to ACESFilmic, and shadowMap enabled.
